title: SiteBatch
description: EWDS Topic schema for Client Gateway payload validation. Envelope for a batch of Site records (int:Site) all belonging to the same Community. Each Site is a physical building within the Community (e.g. a residential block, a commercial building, a school). Maps to cim:ServiceLocation (IEC CIM 61968-11 Customer package). Confirmed in the 2026-05-13 Ontology Workshop: a Community contains one or more Sites. Merges siteId (R2M) and pilotId (TUM).

communityId.description: FK to the Community that all Sites in siteList belong to.

siteId.description: Primary identifier for the Site (pilot deployment location).

siteName.description: Human-readable site name. Maps to CIM IdentifiedObject.name.

description.description: General description of the pilot site, from D2.1 pilot general information.

latitude.description: Anonymised representative latitude, decimal degrees, per D2.1 GDPR guidance.

longitude.description: Anonymised representative longitude, decimal degrees, per D2.1 GDPR guidance.

buildingType.description: Building or facility type at this site, from D2.1 facility category field. Maps to s4bldg:buildingCategory.

marketMechanism.description: Type of energy sharing or trading mechanism permitted, e.g. P2P trading, collective self-consumption, virtual net metering.

co2EmissionFactor.description: Grid CO2 emission factor for this community grid mix, in gCO2/kWh.

fromNodeId.description: Reference to the originating connectivity node of a line segment within the site network topology. Used for power flow modelling and branch-node incidence representation.

toNodeId.description: Reference to the destination connectivity node of a line segment within the site network topology.

lineId.description: Unique identifier of the line segment connecting two nodes within the site network.

operatorId.description: FK to the market participant (household or prosumer, via Actor) that operates the site.

connectedNodeId.description: Reference to the network connectivity node where the market participant is electrically connected within the site network.

conductance.description: Line conductance parameter used in admittance matrix (Y-bus) formulation for power flow calculations, in S. Real component of line admittance.

lineSusceptance.description: Line susceptance parameter used in admittance matrix (Y-bus) formulation for power flow calculations, in S. Imaginary component of line admittance.

transformerReactance.description: Impedance representing the distribution transformer within the site, used in power flow calculations, in Ohm.

minNodeVoltage.description: Minimum allowable nodal voltage magnitude within the site distribution network, in V (or per unit). Operational constraint for power flow analysis.

maxNodeVoltage.description: Maximum allowable nodal voltage magnitude within the site distribution network, in V (or per unit). Operational constraint for power flow analysis.

maxLineFlow.description: Maximum allowable apparent power flowing through line segments within the site network, in VA (or per unit). Thermal/operational line capacity constraint.

phaseConfiguration.description: Phase configuration of the internal site network connections. Typically SinglePhase or ThreePhase. Used for phase-aware power flow modelling.

ownerIds.description: FKs to the owner(s) of the site, via Actor.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created. ISO 8601 with timezone.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated. ISO 8601 with timezone.
